name: Autron
description:
Autron connects Claude to your Amazon Advertising and Seller Central data so you can investigate performance and act on it in the same conversation.

Ask about ACOS, TACOS, spend, sales, and margin across campaigns, ad groups, targets, and ASINs. Compare periods, find what changed, and trace a metric back to the campaigns driving it. Query your own advertising warehouse directly for questions the standard reports don't answer.

Then act: create Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns, add and archive targets, update bids and placement multipliers, adjust budgets, and set advertising goals. Write actions are annotated as destructive, so Claude asks before it changes anything in your account.

Autron also exposes your product catalog, inventory and stock signals, brand assets, and a full action log of changes made on your behalf — so you can audit what happened and when.

Requires an Autron account with a connected Amazon Advertising profile. Manage connected apps and revoke access at any time from Settings → AI assistants in Autron.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Autron to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Autron to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agent.autron.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Autron MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Autron lists 36 MCP tools, including add_ads, add_targets, amazon_seller_central_search, archive_campaigns, archive_targets, autron_help_center_search, autron_website_search, create_goal, create_product_cost, create_sb_campaigns, create_sd_campaigns, and create_sp_campaigns.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Autron?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Autron in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Autron requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Autron is developed by Autron, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
